|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 3) of the Virtual Modern Alternate Image (ALT) card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Asajj Ventress With Lightsabers (ALT) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2). The image is the Players Committee high-resolution card image of this version ([[:File:VAI-D-asajjventresswithlightsabers_ai-2021-08-10-hires.png]]); no card-size GIF of this image was ever committed, which is why it was missing from the version list until the PC's high-resolution images were compared with the card-size images (ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026). Each version below is a published PC printing; card-image dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository. Every visibly different printing is a separate version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026); a later copy of the same image in another format is not (13 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC high-resolution card image uploaded 10 August 2021<ref name="img-altpng-25e5dad-asajjventresswithlightsabersai">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/hires/asajjventresswithlightsabers_ai.png</code> (high-resolution image) in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/25e5dad5826a9bb8e047c10fe325460bda7a7edc commit 25e5dad] (10 August 2021) (“Virtual AI pack series 2”). No card-size GIF of this image was committed (the card-size image <code>large/…</code> was never made from it); the PC served this PNG at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/hires/asajjventresswithlightsabers_ai.png until it was replaced (today's copy is the latest version only), and GEMP showed the high-resolution image.</ref>. The earliest published image of this card: it was only ever committed as a high-resolution PNG, so version lists built from the card-size images missed it (ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Amanin”. Text: “Power +1 with Dooku. Permanent weapon is •Asajj's Lightsabers (may target a character for free, or target two characters using 1 Force; draw two destiny; target(s) hit and forfeit -2 if total destiny > total defense value).”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Asajj Ventress With Lightsabers (ALT) (Errata)]]): '''What changed''' (compared with the previous version, the high-resolution image of 10 August 2021): re-made for the PC's January 2022 Alternate Image update: the copyright line “Artwork not affiliated or endorsed by Lucasfilm Ltd.” → “ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD.”, and the art credit, icons and text box were redrawn or moved. PC card image of 15 January 2022<ref name="ht-asa-0">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/793bf65/Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/asajjventresswithlightsabers_ai.gif asajjventresswithlightsabers_ai.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/793bf65 793bf65] (15 January 2022).</ref>, no errata mark.  Text: “Power +1 with Dooku. Permanent weapon is •Asajj's Lightsabers (may target a character for free, or target two characters using 1 Force; draw two destiny; target(s) hit and forfeit -2 if total destiny > total defense value).”
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Asajj Ventress With Lightsabers (ALT) (Errata 2)]]): '''First published 11 December 2022''' as the high-resolution PNG <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/hires/asajjventresswithlightsabers_ai.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/e9980f98a20d3e39594e801ec9cc0d58d1cab545 commit e9980f9]); the card-size image cited next is a later copy of the same image (a version is dated by its first publication in any format; ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026). PC card image of 12 December 2022<ref name="ht-asa-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/12d0bca/Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/asajjventresswithlightsabers_ai.gif asajjventresswithlightsabers_ai.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/12d0bca 12d0bca] (12 December 2022).</ref>, no errata mark. What changed from the previous image: the “SWCCG Players Committee” logo is added at the bottom right, before “(AI)”. Same words. (A re-encoded copy of 5 July 2022 shows no visible change.) It is the current image. Text: “Power +1 with Dooku. Permanent weapon is •Asajj's Lightsabers (may target a character for free, or target two characters using 1 Force; draw two destiny; target(s) hit and forfeit -2 if total destiny > total defense value).”
Versions follow Bill's ruling of 12 November 2026: every visible change on a PC card image is a version (the PC's own E marks count only its announced errata).
